findings.title: Missing React key on Grafana list item
findings.body: In FilterViewResults the `grafana` case renders <GrafanaRuleListItem> without `key={key}` while the `datasource` and `unknown` cases pass `key`. The `key` field was computed to prevent duplication (`getRuleKey`). Without it React will warn and mis-reconcile list updates during infinite scroll/filtering, causing wrong rows to be reused or state to leak between rules.

findings.title: Delete/Pause unreachable without rulerRule
findings.body: AlertRuleMenu ORs ruler and prom abilities to compute canDelete/canPause, but rendering is still gated on ruler data: line 123 requires `rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rulerRule)` for Pause and line 165 requires `rulerRule &&` for Delete. GrafanaRuleListItem in the list view now passes only promRule, so rulerRule is undefined and Delete/Pause never render even when grafana abilities allow them, breaking delete/pause from the alert list.

findings.title: Silence drawer never opens for prom-only rules
findings.body: RuleActionsButtons shows Silence menu via promRule abilities, but the drawer is gated on `rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule)` where `rule` is the optional rulerRule. When only promRule is provided (new list view), the condition is always false, so clicking Silence notifications sets showSilenceDrawer but renders nothing. The user gets no drawer and no error.
